Two refinements: (1) the buzz frequency multiplier (uTime * 45.0) risks reading as jittery flicker rather than a warm hum — halve it to ~20 and widen the Gaussian envelope (reduce the 80.0 exponent to ~40) so the shimmer reads as a slow, fat pulse traveling the strand; (2) the fragment shader palette is truncated but ensure the buzz-glow tint stays within earth-warm territory (amber/honey, not white-hot) so the glow moment feels like a kazoo's brassy warmth rather than an electrical short.
